ADDED i2: Tests for {@link UnicodeEscaper}, which escapes selected code points into their {@code \\uXXXX} Unicode representation.

The behaviour under test depends on h
ADDED i3: The default escaper escapes every code point. Integer.MAX_VALUE is above 0xFFFF, so it is escaped via the multi-digit hex form "\\u7FFFFFFF".
ADDED i4: above(571) escapes any code point greater than 571. The code point 629 (0x0275) qualifies and is escaped as "\\u0275".
ADDED i5: between(low, high) only escapes code points inside the inclusive range. -2931 falls below the [-2014, -2014] range, so it is left untouched.
ADDED i6: outsideOf(1151, 91) escapes code points outside the exclusive range, i.e. below 1151 or above 91. The code point 629 (0x0275) is below 1151 and so is escaped as
ADDED i7: between(55296, 1166) has its low boundary above its high boundary, so the inclusive range is empty. The code point 55296 satisfies neither bound and is therefor
ADDED i8: below(0) escapes code points below 0. Translating the CharSequence "5F8" starts at code point '5' (0x35), which is not below 0, so nothing is escaped and the wr
